subject: Jimjar

fact: The party emerged from an unexpected detour through the Underdark.

subject: Thorin

subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin predicts that the current path will end in tears.

fact: Jimjar offers to place a small wager.

fact: The bet regarding the path ending in tears is accepted.

fact: Thorin chooses the left branch at the next intersection based on a coin flip.
